LogGI50_M: Log of the GI50 result, unit: M.
LogGI50_u: Log of the GI50 result, unit: ug/mL.
LogGI50_V: Log of the GI50 result, unit: Volumetric.
IndnGI50: Number of tests averaged for the GI50 value for this NSC and cell line.
StddevGI50: Standard Deviation of the Log10 of the GI50 result averaged across all tests for this NSC and cell line.
LogTGI_M: Log of the TGI result, unit: M.
LogTGI_u: Log of the TGI result, unit: ug/mL.
LogTGI_V: Log of the TGI result, unit: Volumetric.
IndnTGI: Number of tests averaged for the TGI value for this NSC and cell line.
StddevTGI: Standard Deviation of the Log10 of the TGI result averaged across all tests for this NSC and cell line.
